# Livermore kernel performance — CPython vs compiled JS vs auto-routed WASM

*Generated by `bench/livermore/perf.mjs` (median of 3 whole-process runs,
startup baseline subtracted, loop counts x400 the correctness suite).
Correctness for every row is enforced separately in CI
(`tests/differential/livermore/run.mjs` — byte-identical output on all
three backends). Machine-dependent: regenerate locally before citing.*

| Kernel | CPython (ms) | JS (ms) | WASM (ms) | JS/CPython | WASM/JS | Faster backend |
|---|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|---|
| k01_hydro | 88.3 | 90.8 | 13.2 | 1.0x | 6.88x | wasm |
| k02_iccg | 43.9 | 38.3 | 16.5 | 1.1x | 2.33x | wasm |

WASM wins 24/24 kernels at this scale. Startup overhead dominates the light kernels (the Axon finding); the heavy loop nests are where the WASM path pays.
